column1: # A coding profile binds one model, one runtime, and one workspace to the
# bounds a job runs under, the way scripts/web-profiles.tsv binds a serving
# profile to its fetch budgets. maximum_context comes from and may not
# exceed the model's validated_filled_depth; maximum_files_changed and
# maximum_patch_bytes bound what code.apply_patch may export;
# maximum_job_seconds bounds the whole job wall clock and the service kills
# the job's process group past it. allowed_test_profile names the one
# command set code.run_tests resolves; network_policy is `loopback-llama`
# for every row because the contained task environment reaches exactly the
# local llama-server. execution_policy decides whether the service accepts
# a job at all. code-fast-a reads `validator-gated`: the model-depth,
# switch-policy, containment, and full-chain admission gates passed and
# evidence/coding-agent/chain-admission/ retains the qwenseer-2b run.
# code-deep-a stays `refused` until the full chain passes against the 7B:
# its filled-depth arm now validates 32768 (maximum_context matches), so the
# re-entry gate is a chain rerun at that depth under the evict-first
# transition, the depth Qwen Code's own 16-18k-token opening request needs.
